goal.decided: The user gets their queued Claude Code tasks done in the hours nobody answers, through the usage limit, instead of spending the daytime limit on them: in the evening they queue tasks to start at a set time, and in the morning they read which tasks finished and which were given up, and merge the results from their main session.
